title: EnvironmentContext
description: SAIA-Class S environment context representing the situational metadata required for governance decisions within Beast System 3.0.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the decision or event was initiated.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction label (e.g., city, state, region, DAO zone).

channel.description: Optional channel through which the decision was triggered (API, UI, automated, system, etc.).

metadata.description: Optional metadata for domain-specific or environmental extensions.
